Name: Vietnamese Beverage
Author: IAMJULIES
Description:
[size=6][font=Impact]Description[/font][/size]
Welcome to the active preview of Vietnamese Beverage! This mod introduces the rich, aromatic, and distinct world of Vietnamese drink culture to Pelican Town. From robust street-side coffees to refreshing tropical refreshments, this pack aims to completely level up your Stardew Valley beverage game.

[i][b]Please note[/b]: This is an active Early Access/Demo release published primarily to configure update keys and gather initial feedback.[/i]

🍹 Currently Featured (5 of 7 Planned Items)
We have successfully implemented 5 core drinks, custom crops, and an artisan machine in this current preview release:

* The Legendary Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng): A sweet, liquid masterpiece combining strong, robust coffee with a rich, velvety egg-yolk foam layer.
* Vietnamese Iced Milk Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá): The ultimate street-side classic. A potent, slow-dripped coffee sweetened with rich condensed milk over ice—guaranteed to give your farmer a serious energy kick!
* Salt Coffee (Cà Phê Muối): A trendy, modern specialty. A perfect, sophisticated harmony of bitter robusta coffee, sweet condensed milk, and a savory, creamy salted foam top layer.
* Sugarcane Juice & Custom Crop (Nước Mía): Introduce a brand new tropical crop—Sugarcane (Cây Mía)—to your farm and press it into a super refreshing street drink. The ultimate way to beat the summer heat!
* Pennywort Juice, Custom Crop & Blender Station (Nước Rau Má): Grow vibrant clusters of Pennywort (Rau Má) and grind them into a nutrient-packed juice using a brand new artisan machine—the Blender! It comes complete with fully functional mechanical sound effects while operating.

---

[size=4][font=Impact]⚠️ Gameplay Guide & Mechanics[/font][/size]
Below are the gameplay mechanics, crop statistics, and unlocking conditions hidden under spoiler tags for those who prefer to explore the secrets themselves!
[spoiler]The Blender Machine:
* How to trigger: Once you ship your very first batch of Pennywort (Rau Má), Robin will notice this unique ingredient. The next morning, she will send an invitation letter directly to your mailbox.
* Where to purchase: Reading her invitation letter will officially unlock the Blender Crafting Recipe for purchase at Robin's Carpenter Shop.
* Sugarcane Seeds (Seed Cane): Can be purchased exclusively from Sandy at the Oasis shop in the Calico Desert.
* Pennywort Seeds (Hạt Rau Má):
    * Seasons: Grows in both Spring and Summer.
    * Growth Cycle: Takes 4 days to fully mature, then regrows every 3 days.
    * Special Mechanics: It grows noticeably faster when planted in moist/wet soil conditions. Must be harvested using a Scythe (Liềm) to yield fresh, lush clusters of green Pennywort.[/spoiler]
